UPDATE downloads
            SET status = CASE
                    WHEN status IN ('resolving', 'downloading') THEN 'pending'
                    WHEN status = 'tagging' THEN 'downloaded'
                END,
                version = version + 1,
                next_retry_at = NULL,
                error_message = '上一次执行意外中断，任务已恢复',
                finished_at = NULL,
                updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            WHERE status IN ('resolving', 'downloading', 'tagging')
